name: qtsumm
description: A table-to-text summarization dataset that measures a model's ability to generate coherent natural‑language summaries from structured tables. Evaluates content selection, faithful verbalization of table facts, and conciseness of generated summaries.
evaluation_method: ROUGE / BLEU (automatic text-generation metrics), sometimes complemented by human evaluation
reputation: A niche table-to-text dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in data-to-text research.
